caseName: N. P. Severin Co. v. Young
caseNameFull: The N. P. SEVERIN COMPANY, a Co-partnership of which N. P. Severin and A. N. Severin are Members v. Edithe YOUNG, by Stella Young, her Mother and Nearest Friend
attorneys: Mr. Walter L. Clark, of Baltimore, Md. (George M. Naus, of San Francisco, Cal., of counsel), for petitioners.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
